findings.problem: The release-record exemption is specified as any one path segment under `workbench/shipped_approvals/packages/`, although the Goal limits it to records under `<hash>`. This would let an arbitrary file such as `workbench/shipped_approvals/packages/not-a-hash/approval.json` bypass the long-token scan, expanding the security exception beyond actual release records.
findings.suggestion: Require the intervening segment to be exactly the release-record hash format (for example, 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters), and add a non-hash single-segment path to the look-alike tests that must still return `long_hex`.

summary: The plan has one material path-scope gap: its proposed release-record exemption is broader than the hash-record path named in its goal.
